name: Monte Serra Short Loop
description: The direct route to Tuscany's test climb: 53 km from Lucca up Monte Serra and back. The benchmark effort of every pro who has lived here.

name: Monte Serra Loop
description: The standard Monte Serra circuit: 70 km from Lucca over the climb with the full descent and valley return.

name: Monte Serra Extended Loop
description: The long way round: 94 km and over 1,700 m taking in Monte Serra and the surrounding hills — a proper Tuscan training day.

name: Pizzorne from Villa Basilica
description: Lucca's plateau climb: 57 km with the switchback ascent of the Pizzorne from Villa Basilica — 1,300 m of climbing straight out of the plain.
